# checker

```go
import "github.com/lucasavila00/immutago/internal/checker"
```

Package checker proves structural immutability from Go compiler type information. It follows Go's structural type predicates and checks each component. Shared type obligations form a graph; definite failures propagate to owners. A recursive collection is accepted only when every reachable obligation holds.

## Constants

LibraryPath is the package whose sealed collection implementations are trusted.

```go
const LibraryPath = "github.com/lucasavila00/immutago/pkg/immutable"
```

## func Contains

```go
func Contains(t types.Type) bool
```

Contains reports whether a type stores a marked value or sealed collection. It traverses containers so an unmarked wrapper cannot hide a marked field.

## func IsCollection

```go
func IsCollection(t types.Type) bool
```

IsCollection reports whether t is one of the library's sealed collection types.

## func IsLibraryType

```go
func IsLibraryType(t types.Type, name string) bool
```

IsLibraryType identifies a library type by package identity and name, not spelling at its use site.

## func Marked

```go
func Marked(t types.Type) bool
```

Marked reports whether a struct directly embeds Marker by value.

## func PossibleStorage

```go
func PossibleStorage(t types.Type) bool
```

PossibleStorage reports whether a type can contain immutable storage, including unresolved generic fields. Ordinary interface values contain copies and do not imply stored immutable fields.

## func Reason

```go
func Reason(t types.Type) string
```

Reason returns an empty string when t is proved immutable, or the first failed obligation. Recursive components start provisionally valid. Definite failures propagate through all owners, including cycles, in linear time in the type graph.
